play.said_who: Entry through the IT Global Projects and Business Transformation leaders; the CFO, who ran Global Business Solutions until this year, is the likely economic sponsor.
adds: IT Global Projects is Paolo Biagi. His profile lists AWS, Zero Trust, SailPoint, generative AI and Zoom, and does not mention SAP or S/4HANA. Treat him as the portfolio and governance champion, not yet as the ERP program owner.

ERP-adjacent program owners seen: Aaron Surber (Record to Report IT, consolidating legacy systems into modern ERP, 250+ staff) and Neil Higgins (Business Transformation, SAP Group Reporting). Bill Keillor, VP Business Transformation, is the public-source link above them.
Mainframe leg: Todd Benner owns application strategy and architecture, and a DB2 mainframe DBA team is still visible. That supports the public 'mainframe being retired' claim, as an inference.

Security gate: Shazad Shafi (OT CISO) and Bryan P. (CISO) are the two people to answer early, which is what the play's 'use Devin's isolated machines to answer IT and OT security questions' step needs.
